title: Cozcalt - The Lost Temple - 200 Followers Special
author: Nati797_

generated.description: A large stone temple ruin rising about 127 blocks high, built mostly from stone and stone bricks with quartz, gold and coal block accents, and partly overgrown with oak and jungle leaves, vines and grass. It sits on a rocky, tiered base with a water pool and a sign, and its footprint is roughly 50 by 50 blocks, with a stepped pyramid-like silhouette in the jungle style. The source gives no description of interior contents, so none are claimed.
